name: Party Test
author: S.A.M Framework
description: An unattended test of party members (sam_party_*) and the in-game half of the lobby functions: spawns three party members, reads and changes them, kills them (one comes back, one has respawn off, one is kept dead by a handler), takes the stairs with sam_travel_to_level, and checks who came back. Run it with tools/run_mod_test.sh PartyTest.
